<div class="card-body">
'''Counter Assault''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反撃</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、１ヶ所でのフォース消耗をキャンセルできる。その位置にいる敵のキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークルの合計枚数だけ運命数を引く。そして、自分の運命数の合計と、敵の戦闘力の合計を比較し、少ないほうが、その差だけのフォース消耗を受ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Counter-Assault-SWCA-100697.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国のストームトルーパーは、奇襲攻撃への対抗策として、即座に部隊を再編成し、一挙に形勢を逆転する訓練を受けている。これにより、ハン・ソロの型破りな追撃を阻止できた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Counter Assault.

'''Card text:'''
Spend 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw as many destiny draws as there are enemy characters, starships and vehicles at that location. Compare your destiny total with the enemy’s total power. The side with the lower total suffers a Force drain equal to the difference.

'''Lore:'''
Imperial stormtroopers train to regroup immediately and reverse the situation in one move in response to a surprise attack. This let them stop Han Solo’s unorthodox pursuit.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses フォース消耗 for both the canceled Force drain and the loss applied after comparing totals.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Counter Assault]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
